hero_subtitle: I engineer secure access for a connected world.
hero_description: I am a Cybersecurity Engineer specializing in network access control and endpoint security. With a passion for automation and a proven record in Fortune 500 environments, I design and defend robust, identity-driven security frameworks.
about_mission: My mission is to assist enterprises and startups in architecting robust, identity-driven security frameworks and automation that guarantee secure network access and protect critical infrastructure with absolute trust.
service_ui_desc: I design, deploy, and manage advanced Cisco ISE and RADIUS/TACACS+ systems, securing wired, wireless, and VPN access through granular, context-aware user policies.
service_dev_desc: I implement comprehensive device profiling, posture-compliance assessments, and modern agent configurations, keeping unauthorized or non-compliant devices off critical layers.
service_graphic_desc: I develop robust automation scripts and playbooks leveraging Python, PowerShell, and bash to speed up threat detection, automate policy edits, and reduce human operational error.
service_branding_desc: I architect micro-segmented networks, perform detailed threat modeling, and review ingress/egress points to safeguard high-value servers and data repositories from persistent attacks.
future_plans_description: The cybersecurity landscape is ever-evolving, and so am I. I am committed to staying at the forefront of the industry. Here are my current strategic directives:
future_plans_isc2cc: Establish a comprehensive, vendor-neutral foundation in cybersecurity principles. This certification validates essential knowledge across key domains, including access controls, network security, security operations, and the core tenets of confidentiality, integrity, and availability required for any security role.
future_plans_ccna: Achieve mastery of modern network infrastructure by validating core skills in network access, IP connectivity, and security fundamentals. This certification will solidify expertise in configuring and managing wired and wireless networks, understanding network automation, and implementing foundational security policies on Cisco devices.
future_plans_az500: Deepen expertise in cloud security by mastering the implementation of advanced security controls and threat protection in Microsoft Azure. This involves managing identity and access, securing networking, hardening virtual machines, and orchestrating security operations to protect data, applications, and infrastructure at enterprise scale.
future_plans_az204: Bridge the gap between development and security by gaining proficiency in building, testing, and maintaining secure cloud-native applications on Azure. Key skills include implementing secure Azure solutions, developing for Azure storage, and integrating authentication and authorization to embed security throughout the software development lifecycle.
cert_desc_btl1: Validates practical, hands-on skills for real-world defensive security. Holders have demonstrated proficiency in threat intelligence, network security monitoring, digital forensics, and incident response across a wide range of platforms and scenarios.
cert_desc_sixsigma_white: Provides a foundational overview of the Six Sigma methodology. White Belts understand the basic concepts, vocabulary, and their roles within a quality-focused organization, enabling them to support improvement projects.
cert_desc_sixsigma_yellow: Validates a solid understanding of Six Sigma principles. Yellow Belts are valuable team members on projects, capable of applying basic tools, collecting data, and understanding process maps to assist Green and Black Belts.
cert_desc_sixsigma_green: Demonstrates proficiency in leading and executing process improvement projects. Green Belts are experts in the DMAIC framework, utilizing statistical analysis and project management skills to solve quality problems and deliver tangible business results.
cert_desc_sixsigma_black: The highest level of Six Sigma certification. Black Belts are experts in advanced statistical analysis and project leadership, capable of managing complex, cross-functional improvement projects that drive significant organizational change and financial benefits.
cert_desc_cct: Validates essential skills for on-site support and maintenance of Cisco networking and system devices. Focuses on remedial services, hardware replacement, and configuration to restore functionality, ensuring operational continuity.
cert_desc_az900: Provides a foundational understanding of cloud concepts and core Microsoft Azure services. It covers cloud principles, Azure architecture, security, privacy, compliance, and trust, as well as Azure pricing and support.
cert_desc_isc2_candidate: Recognizes individuals on their path to achieving a full (ISC)² certification like the CISSP. It signifies a commitment to the cybersecurity profession and adherence to the (ISC)² Code of Ethics while gaining the necessary work experience.
cert_desc_cy_analyst: Focuses on the skills required for a Security Operations Center (SOC) analyst, including threat monitoring, detection, and analysis. It covers behavioral analytics to identify and combat malware and advanced persistent threats (APTs).
cert_desc_cloud_plus: Demonstrates the skills needed to implement and maintain cloud technologies. It validates knowledge of cloud security controls, infrastructure management, and best practices for deploying and automating secure cloud environments.
cert_desc_ccna: A foundational networking certification that validates the ability to install, configure, operate, and troubleshoot medium-sized routed and switched networks. It also includes verification and implementation of connections to remote sites in a WAN.
cert_desc_cissp_cns: Covers a core domain of the CISSP, focusing on securing network architecture, communication channels, and mitigating network-based attacks. Validates expertise in protocols, segmentation, and wireless security.
cert_desc_win10_ad: Demonstrates proficiency in managing and securing Windows 10 endpoints within an Active Directory environment. Covers Group Policy Objects (GPOs), user and computer account management, and troubleshooting client connectivity.
cert_desc_secplus_threats: Focuses on identifying and analyzing threat actors, intelligence sources, and system vulnerabilities. This credential validates the ability to use threat intelligence to support organizational security and proactively hunt for threats.
cert_desc_az_admin_aad: Covers core skills for administering Azure Active Directory, including tenant and domain management, Enterprise State Roaming, Identity Protection, and Self-Service Password Reset (SSPR).
cert_desc_sec_risk_mgmt: Validates expertise in managing security controls through a structured approach, covering risk management, user security, session management, and data encryption techniques.
cert_desc_ws2016_gpo: Validates proficiency in the function, configuration, and processing of Active Directory Group Policy Objects (GPOs) for centralized configuration management in Windows Server 2016 environments.
